description: Climate-index definitions for precomputed yearly, 5-year, and decade heat layers.

five_year.label: 5-year
five_year.display_hint: Mean annual value inside a 5-year block.

decade.label: Decade
decade.display_hint: Mean annual value inside a decade.

days_above_threshold.label: Days above threshold
days_above_threshold.description: Number of days in a year where the selected variable is greater than or equal to the selected threshold.

share_days_above_threshold.label: Share of days above threshold
share_days_above_threshold.description: Fraction of days in a year where the selected variable is greater than or equal to the selected threshold.

ever_reaches_threshold.label: Ever reaches threshold
ever_reaches_threshold.description: Whether the selected threshold is reached at least once in the period.

years_with_any_exceedance.label: Years with any exceedance
years_with_any_exceedance.description: Number of years in a multi-year window where the selected threshold is reached at least once.

max_consecutive_days_above_threshold.label: Longest hot spell
max_consecutive_days_above_threshold.description: Longest consecutive run of days above the selected threshold.

hot_spell_count.label: Hot spell count
hot_spell_count.description: Number of hot spells above the selected threshold. A hot spell is a run of at least the configured minimum spell length.

txx.label: TXx / annual maximum Tmax
txx.description: Annual maximum of daily maximum temperature.

tx90p.label: TX90p / warm days
tx90p.description: Percentage of days where daily maximum temperature exceeds a local baseline 90th percentile.

wsdi.label: WSDI / warm spell duration index
wsdi.description: Count of days that are part of warm spells, using a local percentile threshold and a minimum spell length.
